[{"insert":"Deficit Deadlift Progression

This is the last deadlift of the cycle. Standing on the plate makes you reach farther to the bar, so your hamstrings and glutes work hardest right at the start of the pull. Reps are at their lowest this week, so this should be your heaviest pulling of the whole block. Brace hard, keep the bar tight to your body, and aim to beat Week 4.
"}]
